deadmines-geared.title: The Deadmines at level 20
deadmines-geared.summary: Five level-20 characters start in Northshire with green gear and their class spells trained: a tank, a healer and three damage dealers. The goal is to clear the Deadmines and kill Edwin VanCleef. The clock is two hours.
deadmines-geared.scoring: Whether the party earns the Deadmines achievement, then how long it takes. Each boss killed is a checkpoint, so an unfinished run shows how far it got.

duelling.title: Duelling at level 60
duelling.summary: Every model duels every other model once, five duels a pairing. Each plays a level-60 Frost Mage in identical gear and talents, starting face to face at an open spot. Health and mana are not restored between duels, and each pairing has 20 minutes.
duelling.scoring: Duels won, as a rating across every pairing (Bradley-Terry on the Elo scale, 1500 the average) with its 95% range. The head-to-head grid shows each pairing's score.

hardcore.title: Hardcore levelling
hardcore.summary: A new level-1 Human Arms warrior starts in Northshire with four hours. The first death ends the run.
hardcore.scoring: Total XP earned before the first death or the end of the four hours. Level reached is shown alongside.

hogger.title: Hogger from level 1
hogger.summary: Three new level-1 characters start in Northshire: a Protection Paladin, a Holy Priest and a Frost Mage. The goal is the quest "Wanted: Hogger", whose target is an elite level-11 gnoll. The clock is three hours.
hogger.scoring: Whether the quest is completed, then how long it takes.

travel.title: Travel to the four Alliance capitals
travel.summary: A new level-30 Human warrior starts in Northshire and has to visit Stormwind, Ironforge, Darnassus and the Exodar, in any order, across two continents and an island: the tram, three boats, a portal and the roads between. Each model plays one character, all at the same time, with 120 minutes.
travel.scoring: Whether the character reaches all four, then how long it takes; a run that doesn't counts the cities it reached. Cost is at list prices.

ubrs.title: Upper Blackrock Spire at level 60
ubrs.summary: Ten level-60 characters, every Alliance class but the death knight, start at Morgan's Vigil in pre-raid dungeon gear: two tanks, three healers and five damage dealers. The goal is to clear Upper Blackrock Spire and kill General Drakkisath. The clock is two hours.
ubrs.scoring: Whether the party earns the Upper Blackrock Spire achievement, then how long it takes. Each boss killed is a checkpoint, so an unfinished run shows how far it got.
